name: PUBLISHED_TABLE_VERIFIER_COVERAGE_CLOSURE_GATE
purpose: Fail closed when a repository claims that published tables are rebuilt from raw rows but the verifier checks only a subset of numeric cells, silently omits a table, or validates a rate through a different denominator than the displayed rate.
scope: Static evidence-package verification. This gate does not establish scientific validity, historical run-time nonrepudiation, or causal correctness by itself.
required_bindings: immutable table/blob identity for every table in the claimed publication surface
explicit inventory of every claimed numeric/data cell or an equivalent schema-level coverage manifest
one-to-one mapping from each claimed numeric/data cell to a reducer/verifier check, with declared exclusions limited to labels/non-data presentation fields
raw-row source identity and join/grouping keys for each checked cell
metric semantics, including population, valid/scored subset, skipped/refused/error treatment, numerator and denominator for each rate
verifier source revision and deterministic reducer semantics
coverage closure assertion that fails when a table or numeric/data field is unmapped
mismatch assertion that fails when a mapped cell differs from the recomputed value
fail_closed_conditions: a CSV/table is within the claimed publication surface but absent from the verifier registry
a row mapper checks success_count but leaves success_rate, denominator or other claimed numeric fields unchecked
a displayed rate uses n_tasks while the verifier recomputes on n_valid, unless the rate itself is explicitly checked against its displayed denominator
the verifier reports zero mismatches without proving coverage closure
a test asserts only verifier exit status or a zero-mismatch string but never asserts that every claimed numeric/data cell is covered
an aggregate 'cells verified' count is derived from mapper yields rather than from an independently enumerated publication-cell manifest

adversarial_controls.reason: A correct count does not attest the displayed denominator or rate.
Zero mismatches on the registered subset is not exhaustive publication coverage.
Metric provenance is inconsistent even if numerator counts match.
Coverage and value equality are both closed.
Independent inventory closes the silent-omission class.

observed_trigger.finding: The public verifier checks ScienceWorld success-count cells but omits the entire baseline_gpt_20fam.csv, trend z/p/slope fields, and the eval table's denominator/rate/raw-mean/full-score/negative-score fields. Its final checked-cell count is the number of mapper-emitted checks, so '0 mismatched' does not prove exhaustive table coverage.

phase1_assessment.accepted_use: As a scheduled-Chat-native fail-closed gate over immutable public text/JSON/CSV/source artifacts.
not_established: scientific correctness of the underlying experiment
